name: sim_clifford_rotor_norm_micro

micro.function_surface: clifford.Cl(3) MultiVector geometric product, reverse (~), and rotor sandwich R*v*~R
micro.micro_claim: A Cl(3) unit-bivector rotor has scalar norm R*~R == 1, preserves vector norm under sandwich action, and remains unit under rotor composition.
micro.lego_target: minimal Cl(3) rotor fixture; pre-lego anchor for later Hopf/spinor targets
micro.why_this_lego: The fixture isolates the rotor norm gate required before Clifford rotor surfaces are used in tool-lego or tool-tool coupling work.
micro.positive_case: Unit rotors built from e12/e13/e23 at several angles satisfy R*~R == ~R*R == 1 and preserve vector norm.
micro.negative_case: A non-unit even multivector and a non-unit bivector coefficient are excluded by the same norm gate.
micro.boundary_case: Identity, 2*pi, 4*pi, and tiny-angle rotors stay inside the expected Spin(3) norm boundary.
micro.demotion_condition: Any unit rotor with |scalar(R*~R)-1| > 1e-10, non-scalar norm residue > 1e-10, or sandwich vector-norm drift > 1e-10 demotes this function surface.
out_of_scope: bridge, coexistence, topology-variant, emergence, or axis-level claims
